description: This file defines the InMemoryReminderTable class, which implements reminder table operations in memory for the Orleans distributed framework. It manages reminder entries, interacts with a grain interface, and participates in the silo lifecycle.

classes.name: InMemoryReminderTable
classes.description: Implements an in-memory reminder table for Orleans, managing reminder entries and lifecycle participation.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the reminder table, currently a no-op.

methods.name: ReadRow
methods.description: Reads a specific reminder row for a given grain ID and reminder name.

methods.name: ReadRows
methods.description: Reads all reminder rows for a given grain ID.

methods.name: ReadRows
methods.description: Reads reminder rows within a range specified by begin and end.

methods.name: RemoveRow
methods.description: Removes a reminder row identified by grain ID, reminder name, and eTag.

methods.name: TestOnlyClearTable
methods.description: Clears the reminder table, intended for testing purposes.

methods.name: UpsertRow
methods.description: Inserts or updates a reminder entry.

methods.name: ThrowIfNotAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the service is available; throws if not.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Participates in the silo lifecycle, managing availability state on start and stop.
